card.name: Forro
card.tagline: Northeastern Brazilian couples dance and music super-genre.
card.profile: Forro is a Northeastern Brazilian couples dance and musical super-genre. Traditional 'pe-de-serra' forro is marked by zabumba, triangle and accordion (sanfona); couples dance face-to-face, dragging their feet (hence 'arrasta-pe'). Created in Pernambuco and popularized nationwide from the 1950s by Luiz Gonzaga, the 'Rei do Baiao.' It encompasses xote, xaxado, baiao and others (English Wikipedia; Agencia Brasil).
card.insight: NOT a UNESCO element. On 9 December 2021 IPHAN's heritage council registered the 'traditional matrices of forro' as Patrimonio Cultural do Brasil and classified it a musical super-genre (Agencia Brasil).
